principle: edge occupation should make the street inhabited without converting every visual habit into persistent agent state

habits.meaning: repair work chooses shade and edge space
objects can imply repeated use without an NPC present
manual work occupies one edge while leaving circulation free
an unexplained prepared place may remain empty

rules: habits never enter campaign saves, journals, economy or knowledge
ambient figures are presentation studies, not authoritative NPCs or witnesses
challenged/fighting phases may reduce visible work without creating a remembered reaction
future crowd/occupation generators may surround these habits but not clone them uniformly
